_comment: SYNTHETIC. Drives jwicket.fixtures.LiveModel for the development server: a two-node chassis-cluster session table whose flows follow this fixture's root policies (node0-mgmt-out, inside-out). Every session is listed on both nodes under the same session-identifier. The CLI sample of show security flow session extensive node all shows the same Session ID on both nodes, Active and Backup, with zero counters on the backup (verified for CLI text); the XML list reply is not recorded (Q-REL-01), so the browser's pairing of copies is exercised here, not proven. The node1 copy has zero counters (the backup copy, Spec 004 section 7.5) and no role field is sent, so the browser's inference path is used. node1 reports a slightly smaller, deterministic active count than node0. Close reasons are documented session-close reasons; which one a profile gets is the fixture's choice. 'alg' is an emulation choice (that a DNS session reports application dns is inferred). Message wording is illustrative, not verified against a device.
